statements.statement: The denial reason code was CO-197

statements.basis: denial_letter states 'the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered'
statements.statement: The required prior authorization was missing
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and unspecified atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management
